Replaying that render with the r4 root reproduces both the r4 on-disk configs and the r4 manifest digests exactly for all three roles (calibration). Replaying it with the frozen r5 root yields uninterrupted_control=0862ab534e851e58db1e41cbfac68544250c5be218b4f1c41a76d3235538953e, resumed_parent=c19bb8e5193a92d087864787c980315f7578e0f4bdc1c6aabbaaeda880a293f6, resumed_child=02f4d395d0844913832f30685969eef050a80733300c791d95acace9558d6218, while the manifest and packet still declare the r4 values 08eae66e..., 7e24e6bf..., 2daf76ee.... A unified diff of the r4 and r5 renders differs only in run.artifact_root (all roles) and resume.checkpoint_dir (resumed_child).
findings.failure_scenario: setup (the cache-preparation command) launches and returns zero; _validate_setup then raises packet_executor.setup_config_mismatch on the first role. The O_EXCL marker, the r5 artifact root, the private pack cache, and the outer-receipt target are already consumed, so the one-shot attempt is burned before any GPU command runs.
findings.smallest_fix: Replace the three config_files expected_sha256 values in the manifest and the three digests in the packet 'Deterministic roles and exact six-command order' paragraph with the r5 renders above; re-freeze the manifest and packet SHA-256 and re-review.
findings.summary: All three config_files.*.expected_sha256 values in the manifest (and the same three digests quoted in the packet) are the Attempt-4 digests; the rendered role configs embed the artifact root, which changed from -r4 to -r5, so every digest must change.
findings.verification: Re-run the render reconstruction against the frozen r5 artifact root and require equality with the manifest values for all three roles, and require that reconcile_exact_resume_packet_executor._validate_contract accepts the re-frozen manifest.

findings.evidence: reconcile_exact_resume_packet_executor._validate_success_receipt builds the resumed_parent run spec with "status": "running" and _validate_gpu_run_state fails closed unless run.json['status'] equals it. src/artifacts/run_writer.py assigns the top-level status only at creation ('initialized', line 183) and in finalize(), which rejects anything other than 'completed'/'failed' (line 1013); record_checkpoint_publication_event updates completed_steps/consumed_packs/checkpoint_event_count without touching status. A SIGTERM-terminated held parent never reaches finalize. Real artifacts confirm this: outputs/probes/coordexp_swift/wave7_exact_resume/2026-08-12-core-3 and -core-4 runs/interrupted_parent/run.json both record status='initialized', completed_at=null, completed_steps=3, checkpoint_event_count=1, one completed step-3 publication event, and full launcher_attestations. The 96/96 green executor suite does not cover this because its fixture (_run_state(parent_dir, status='running', completed_steps=1)) is synthetic.
findings.failure_scenario: setup, success.uninterrupted_control, and the entire success.resumed_child arm (held parent to step 1, SIGTERM, child resume to step 2 - the most expensive GPU work in the packet) all run and return zero; artifact GPU validation then raises packet_executor.gpu_artifact_run_state 'resumed_parent run state/progress mismatched'. The attempt is burned at the last GPU command with no qualification result.
findings.smallest_fix: In _validate_success_receipt, bind the resumed_parent spec to the real controlled-exit shape - expected status 'initialized' (equivalently: neither 'completed' nor 'failed'), retaining the existing completed_at-is-None, progress, event and topology checks - and replace the synthetic status='running' parent fixture in tests/training/test_reconcile_exact_resume_packet_executor.py with the real interrupted shape plus a node proving a 'completed' or 'failed' parent is rejected. This is a Step-4 implementation change and therefore re-freezes the implementation commit, manifest, and packet.
findings.summary: The executor requires the interrupted resumed_parent run.json to carry status 'running', a value the production RunWriter can never write; the real controlled-exit state is 'initialized'.
findings.verification: conda run -n ms pytest -q tests/training/test_reconcile_exact_resume_packet_executor.py, plus a read-only replay of _validate_gpu_run_state against a real interrupted-parent run.json (wave7_exact_resume/2026-08-12-core-4/runs/interrupted_parent/run.json) requiring PASS, and against a 'completed' parent requiring fail-closed.

residual_evidence_boundary: No packet command, cache preparation, model, torchrun, GPU allocation, marker acquisition, or output-target mutation was executed by this review; all execution evidence is replay against immutable prior artifacts.
